objective.not: Replace income tax with Tax X
objective.is: Move government revenue away from taxing ordinary work and ownership of a home, and toward use of public systems, extraction of finite resources, creation of public costs, consumption above ordinary needs, external demand, economic rents, and returns on assets the public helped create.

philosophical_transition.FEE_RENT_ROYALTY: Payment for use, consumption, depletion, or receipt of value from a public asset/system
philosophical_transition.RETURN: Arkansas earns because Arkansans own productive assets
philosophical_transition.direction: Over time, reduce TAX as FEE/RENT/ROYALTY and RETURN grow

count_rule: Refuse to count any engine dollar toward the ~$7.23B IIT+property replacement requirement until it has an evidence-backed cash-flow model that is incremental, stress-tested, legally available, and reserved for the same essential obligations.

constitutional_guardrails.import_export_clause: No Arkansas impost/duty on imports or exports as such (U.S. Const. Art. I, § 10, cl. 2).
constitutional_guardrails.commerce_clause: No discriminatory tax on goods leaving Arkansas or undue burden on interstate commerce; generally applicable taxes/use taxes with nexus remain available.

rejected_designs.idea: Discriminatory tax on goods exported from Arkansas (incl. food-export tax)
rejected_designs.redirect: Capture value chain inside Arkansas (food hub / processing / logistics / cooperative ownership returns) before product leaves

rejected_designs.idea: State tax on interstate imports for national defense
rejected_designs.redirect: Federal defense responsibility; Arkansas pursues defense/aerospace/procurement as External Income

rejected_designs.idea: Energy export tax / discriminatory interstate surcharge
rejected_designs.redirect: Production royalties, public land leases, transmission access, generation partnerships, public ownership interests, utility dividends

constitutional_guardrails.allowed_posture: Generally applicable taxes and use taxes with sufficient connection; user fees reasonably corresponding to systems used or costs imposed; ownership returns from lawful public productive interests.

earmark_principle: Where feasible, revenue should map to purpose: road-use→transportation; energy→energy+Prosperity Fund; visitor→tourism/community infrastructure; carbon impact→remediation/resilience; workforce→education/training; depletion→permanent fund; value capture→community infrastructure.

engines.name: Use — pay for use, not existence
engines.what_pays: Use of scarce/public infrastructure and systems
engines.design_rule: Fee should reasonably correspond to the public system used or cost imposed
engines.addressable_base_status: PARTIAL — fuel/highway bound; freight VMT, aviation, water/waste incremental bases NEE
engines.authority: State/local user fees and special revenues within constitutional fee/tax distinction and Highway Revenue Distribution constraints

plausible_incremental_range_usd_per_year.note: Existing ~$0.38B+ fuel stream shows Use can be material statewide, but is already dedicated to highways

engines.incidence: Users of infrastructure; heavy users should pay more than passive homeowners — progressive vs existence-tax if designed well; regressive if flat fees hit low-income mobility
engines.t1_t5_posture: T1 possible at scale for roads; T4 strong if use≠existence; T3 requires mobility equity design

engines.name: Impact — Carbon Balance System
engines.what_pays: Measurable carbon/environmental costs created; restoration can earn
engines.design_rule: Pollution pays; restoration earns — not merely a punitive carbon tax brand
mechanisms: credits/payments for verified sequestration (regenerative ag, reforestation, soil carbon, methane reduction, wetlands, capture)
engines.addressable_base_status: NEE — emissions inventory + MRV design required
engines.authority: Likely requires new statute; federal preemption / EPA interaction / interstate leakage must be mapped
engines.incidence: MIXED — can pass to consumers/workers; credits can help rural ag if additionality real
engines.volatility: Policy and commodity sensitive; credit market risk
engines.t1_t5_posture: T4 philosophically strong; T1/T2/T5 unknown until modeled

engines.name: Depletion — make depletion pay for permanence
engines.design_rule: When a finite Arkansas asset leaves the ground, convert part of proceeds into productive assets that remain
engines.addressable_base_status: PARTIAL — production volumes by commodity NEE for full royalty stack
engines.authority: Severance/royalty statutes; public land lease authority; permanent fund would need statutory design

plausible_incremental_range_usd_per_year.note: Current $10.6M GR severance cannot carry transition; lithium/gas/minerals/water industrial use need commodity-specific models

engines.incidence: Producers / resource owners; may pass into energy/material prices
engines.philosophy: lithium leaves Arkansas → permanent Arkansas wealth remains (not just annual budget spend)
engines.t1_t5_posture: T1 fails at current severance; T2 high volatility; T4 strong if permanent-fund locked

engines.name: Energy as public income (not export tax)
engines.what_pays: Production/infrastructure participation — Arkansans own a share of enabling productive infrastructure
engines.design_rule: Do not discriminate against interstate export; use royalties, leases, transmission access, partnerships, ownership interests, utility dividends

existing_bound_scale.status: OVERLAPS_DEPLETION_AND_ENTERPRISE — no separate energy-ownership return series bound

engines.addressable_base_status: NEE — generation/transmission/ownership map required (ties to Energy Sovereignty research)
engines.authority: Utility regulation, lease statutes, public corporation / partnership law; Commerce Clause bars export-discriminatory taxes
engines.incidence: MIXED — ratepayers vs shareholders vs landowners
engines.constitutional_note: Energy export tax rejected; ownership/participation path preferred
engines.t1_t5_posture: Potentially among largest long-run nontraditional engines — only after ownership cash flows modeled

engines.name: Visitor — external dollars for visitor infrastructure
engines.design_rule: Visitors contribute more than residents to visitor infrastructure; test demand suppression

existing_bound_scale.status: BOUND_SMALL_VS_IIT — already dedicated to tourism marketing

engines.addressable_base_status: PARTIAL — 2% tax bound; full lodging/STR/vehicle base incremental NEE
engines.authority: Existing Parks & Tourism tax (2%); local hospitality options; new tiers need statute/ordinance

plausible_incremental_range_usd_per_year.note: Existing ~$27M shows visitor engine exists but is ~0.7% of IIT; expansion needs demand-elasticity model

engines.incidence: Primarily nonresidents if designed well; residents travel/leisure also hit
engines.earmark: parks + roads + tourism infrastructure + community preservation + local prosperity accounts
engines.t1_t5_posture: T4 strong for external-dollar logic; T1 currently small

engines.name: Luxury — discretionary consumption over ordinary needs
engines.design_rule: Essentials protected (food state rate already 0%); avoid dozens of nuisance taxes; test broad luxury tier yield vs avoidance
mechanisms: second/vacation home transfer taxes (not recurring property tax)
engines.addressable_base_status: NEE — luxury taxable base definition + elasticity
engines.authority: Excise / sales differential statutes; must remain generally applicable / non-discriminatory as to interstate commerce

plausible_incremental_range_usd_per_year.warning: Must not become regressive broad consumption hike rebranded as luxury

engines.incidence: Intended high-discretion buyers; avoidance and definition games are the risk
engines.earmark: optional — prefer transparent purpose funds over opaque GR dump
engines.t1_t5_posture: T3 better than broad sales hike if truly luxury-tier; T1 unknown; prior slice forbids counting sales swap as prosperity-aligned by default

engines.name: Human-capital — Workforce Prosperity Contribution
engines.what_pays: Corporate dependence on publicly built workforce
engines.design_rule: Pay into the workforce system or directly help build the workforce via verified investments
mechanisms: contribution base on payroll / employment / profits or value-added / workforce demand / use of public training
credits for registered apprenticeships, employee education, university partnerships, training facilities, paid internships, rural workforce development

existing_bound_scale.status: EXISTING_CORPORATE_ALREADY_SPENT — WPC is a redesign hypothesis, not free capacity

engines.addressable_base_status: NEE — payroll/value-added base and credit leakage model required
engines.authority: Likely new statute; interaction with corporate income tax and incentive stack
engines.incidence: CRITICAL GATE — corporate taxes can fall on workers, consumers, or shareholders; must model before claiming prosperity alignment
engines.earmark: K-12 → CTE → apprenticeships → community colleges → universities → strategic capacity
engines.t1_t5_posture: T4 strong if credit path real; T3 unresolved until incidence modeled

engines.name: Value Capture — public participation in upside government creates
engines.what_pays: Appreciation / profits created by public investment
engines.design_rule: Public investment → contractual public participation in upside (not hope for jobs alone)
mechanisms: royalties / profit participation from publicly capitalized enterprises
engines.addressable_base_status: NEE — inventory of major incentive/infrastructure packages + legal templates
engines.authority: Local improvement districts, development agreements, lease/authority statutes; gift/loan of credit constraints must be mapped
engines.incidence: Developers / benefited landowners / project sponsors — can be progressive relative to general taxation if targeted
engines.t1_t5_posture: T4 core to 'government makes money'; T1 builds slowly project-by-project

engines.name: Enterprise — revenues/dividends from productive public assets
engines.what_pays: Returns from state/community productive interests (not running grocery stores everywhere)
engines.design_rule: When public capital helps create a productive asset, retain some productive economic interest
engines.authority: Public corporation, authority, and investment statutes; constitutional gift/loan limits
engines.incidence: Returns reduce need for household TAX if real — governance/corruption risk must be controlled
engines.t1_t5_posture: Endgame engine with Enterprise+Prosperity Fund — only counts after demonstrated returns

engines.name: Prosperity Fund — compounded return on accumulated public wealth
engines.what_pays: Investment return on ring-fenced permanent wealth (fed by depletion, energy participation, surplus dedication, etc.)
engines.design_rule: Unmodeled fund earnings are $0 replacement dollars; spend-vs-save rules must protect corpus
mechanisms: automatic Tax Retirement Fund transfers when payout exceeds safety threshold
engines.addressable_base_status: NEE — capital accumulation path + return assumptions + years-to-scale

critical_questions: how many years before material payout vs $3.859B IIT

engines.incidence: Intergenerational — benefits future taxpayers if corpus protected
engines.t1_t5_posture: T4 essential to philosophy; T1 is a multi-decade capital question — refuse premature counting

engines.name: External Income — pull outside dollars into Arkansas
engines.what_pays: Outside demand captured as Arkansas value-add, contracts, and ownership returns — not a tax on leaving
engines.design_rule: Create taxable/profitable value before the product leaves; bring outside dollars in rather than tax Arkansans harder

existing_bound_scale.status: STRATEGY_LAYER — not a single revenue line; tourism/defense/energy overlaps other engines

engines.addressable_base_status: NEE — sector export/GSP and public capture share models
engines.authority: Primarily economic development + ownership design; food-export tax rejected

food_export_redirect.rejected: Specific tax because food is exported to another state
food_export_redirect.preferred: farmer → Arkansas food hub → premium out-of-state market; retain processing/logistics/marketing/cooperative/facility/ownership margins inside Arkansas

defense_redirect.preferred: Defense manufacturing, aerospace, logistics, cybersecurity, veteran pipelines, federal procurement as external income

engines.incidence: Depends on ownership structure — community capture vs leakage
engines.earmark: local prosperity accounts / productive ownership / Tax Retirement Fund when returns exist
engines.t1_t5_posture: Not taxation — state economic strategy that feeds Enterprise/Prosperity Fund over time

engine_summary_table.what_pays: corporate dependence on publicly built workforce
compounded return from accumulated public wealth
outside dollars captured via value chains and contracts (strategy)
